verdict.rationale: React's docs state that you don't have to build your whole page in React and can add it to an existing HTML page or stack, rendering interactive components anywhere without a rewrite (react-docs-1, react-docs-12, react-gh-3). createRoot provides the mechanism for mounting components into any browser DOM node (react-docs-8). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of drop-in integration into server-rendered pages, and evidence of a no-build-step path (JSX and the documented setup imply build tooling).
